note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI declares a charge with an 8% success chance. This is far below its own charge_threshold of 0.47. The unit takes overwatch fire and gains almost nothing. Fix: Gate the charge: if charge_probability is below charge_threshold, return no charge. Multiply every benefit term, including the flat bonuses, by charge_probability. Then subtract the full overwatch cost, which is paid at declaration whether or not the charge succeeds.
suggestion: Stormboyz declares charge against Zodgrod Wortsnagga (8% chance, 10.8" away, expected 22.2 melee dmg vs 5 HP, overwatch risk: 4.1 dmg)
